info.name: MediSlot API
info.description: End-to-end demo flow with assertions. Run top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman). Each run registers fresh users, so it can be repeated against the same database.

exec: // unique per run so the collection can be re-run against the same database
// letters-only token so the name survives the Elasticsearch analyzer and is unlikely to fuzzy-match other docs
// clinic is UTC+6 and the demo doctor works 09:00-17:00: 04:00Z == 10:00 clinic time, two days ahead
const d = new Date(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 2); d.setUTCHours(4, 0, 0, 0);
// 00:00Z == 06:00 clinic time the same day: before the doctor opens at 09:00
